description: Queue a message for delivery to a Discord channel other than the one the current turn is scoped to. This is the fix for the 'jumbling' failure mode: a turn's reply covering two audiences/channels getting blended into one in-turn post instead of split.

tools.name: queue_outbox_message
tools.description: Queue `content` for delivery to `channel`, a Discord channel different from the one this turn is already posting to. Call this the moment a turn's reply would otherwise cover two audiences (e.g. a line for Ian folded into a technical reply meant for another agent) — queue the other channel's message here FIRST, then write this turn's in-channel reply covering only its own channel. Never write one message intended to cover both. Delivered durably by scheduler.py's outbox flush (~1 min cadence), independent of whether this turn is still running.

channel.description: Destination channel name, no leading #. Must be a different channel than the one this turn is scoped to — this tool is for the *other* audience, not a duplicate of the in-turn reply.

content.description: The message body to deliver to that channel.
